name: 4 MP IR Vari-focal Dome Network Camera Hikvision HG20-2CD2735FWD-IZS
summary: Image Sensor: 1/3″ Progressive Scan CMOS Max.
Illumination Color: 0.003 Lux @ (F1.4, AGC ON), B/W: 0 Lux with IR Shutter Time: 1/3 s to 1/100,000 s Day & Night: IR cut filter – IR Range Up to 40 m.
